Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent attack effects atlas for Garden Guard PURPLE LIGHTNING CRYSTAL FLOWER V2. Reference image is ONLY the new lightning orchid tower design and its palette: deep plum outlines, violet crystal petals, bright cream-gold zigzag lightning marks, jade leaves. These are independent visual effect sprites, not full plants. Match the crisp chunky hand-painted cartoon style, readable at small phone game sizes.

ONE1536x1024 PNG, genuine transparent alpha background, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows =12 isolated effects. Equal cells384x341.33, each effect centered within its cell, maximum size270x250px, minimum35px true-alpha empty gutters. No background, fog, glow wash spanning cells, shadows, text, grid, labels, characters, star flowers, ice, snow or mechanical circuit boards. Solid effect silhouettes with soft small internal highlights, true transparent margins. IMPORTANT lightning must be ANGULAR ZIGZAG electricity with sharp stepped forks, not a smooth purple rope or ice snowflake.
